purpose: Draw a tentative conclusion from available signs.
keywords: どうやら + clause; often ようだ / らしい
It looks as though the trains have stopped.
It seems I took the wrong street.
There are no footsteps. Apparently everyone has gone home.
formation: どうやら + clause; often ようだ / らしい
restrictions: Suggests inference rather than direct certainty.
mistake: Do not present it as conclusive proof.
